**<sub><sub>![P2 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P2-yellow?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Keep the capture helper inside the runner's cleanup scope**

When the coverage case reaches `--case-timeout` while capture is active, this creates the capture helper and GDB in a new session. The timeout handler in `run.py` lines 174-180 only signals the harness process group, so it kills the recorder before its `BaseException` cleanup can run but cannot reach this nested session; the capture processes can therefore outlive the timed-out case and overlap a retry after the runner releases its lock. Ensure the helper is tied to the recorder's lifetime or explicitly terminate this separately owned session from the outer timeout path.

Useful? React with 👍 / 👎.
